definitions.explanation: A three-dimensional shape with six rectangular faces, like a box or brick.

examples.english: This box has the shape of a rectangular solid.

examples.english: In elementary school math, students learn the difference between cuboids and cubes, and practice drawing net diagrams.

notes:
A mathematical term used from elementary school onward. A {直方体|ちょくほうたい} has six faces that are all rectangles, with opposite faces being identical. A ⟦{立方体|りっぽうたい}→立方体：05549_rippoutai⟧ (cube) is a special case where all edges are equal.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {直方体|ちょくほうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体積|たいせき}→体積：04492_taiseki⟧: volume of a cuboid
- {直方体|ちょくほうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{表面積|ひょうめんせき}→表面積：28898_hyoumenseki⟧: surface area of a cuboid
- {直方体|ちょくほうたい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{展開図|てんかいず}: net of a cuboid

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{立方体|りっぽうたい}→立方体：05549_rippoutai⟧: cube (all faces are squares)
- {四角柱|しかくちゅう}: rectangular prism
- ⟦{円柱|えんちゅう}→円柱：05551_enchuu⟧: cylinder
- {三角柱|さんかくちゅう}: triangular prism
